scope: Bounded capability-specific traceability population for the five RB1 core runtime capabilities. This registry documents the immutable RB1 source; it does not modify or reopen RB1 science, physics, numerics, performance or release scope.
denominator_definition: Exactly RB1-CORE-INTERVAL, RB1-CORE-DATA, RB1-CORE-TRANSACTION, RB1-CORE-MASS and RB1-CORE-DIAGNOSTICS; the frozen 15-capability RB1 release denominator is unchanged.

nodes.title: Generic interval partition into accepted committed substeps
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 runtime
nodes.notes: A requested [t0,t1] interval is advanced through one or more accepted transaction substeps without a calendar-day assumption.

nodes.title: Canonical interval atomic publication algorithm
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 runtime
nodes.notes: Clone committed state to private working state; execute accepted substeps; publish externally only after the full requested interval completes.

nodes.title: Canonical interval runtime implementation
nodes.notes: Frozen blob 55f3d271aa6200a994fd0144d6fce0701c918a74.

nodes.title: Canonical explicit data-category contract
nodes.notes: The contract separates committed dynamic state, forcing, numerical configuration and results/diagnostics. Model-specific immutable parameters remain model-owned rather than being folded into state.

nodes.title: Canonical data-category type implementation
nodes.notes: Frozen blob c06aa869a0bd479df4c7d6e1d0b4f5c07a207144.

nodes.title: Transactional accept, reject and retry method
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 transaction core
nodes.notes: Each trial starts from the same checkpoint/context; failed solver, mass or temporal gates reject the trial and reduce/retry according to policy; only an accepted route may replace committed state.

nodes.title: Checkpoint trial retry commit rollback algorithm
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 transaction core
nodes.notes: Checkpoint committed physical state and worker-local attempt context; run independent trial branches; restore on rejection; commit exactly the accepted branch.

nodes.title: Reference transaction state, policy and result contract
Water storage change and boundary/source flux exchange over an interval
nodes.notes: Scope is the canonical accounting identity only, not a new hydrological process model.

nodes.title: Independent source binding for conservation-of-water principle
nodes.notes: The conservation principle is operationally required by RB1, but F-DOC03 does not invent or retroactively assign a primary literature/source binding. A controlled theory/source citation remains to be reconciled.

nodes.title: Accepted-state water ledger
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 semantics
nodes.notes: Authoritative accounting contains starting storage, ending storage, accepted inflow, accepted outflow and a completeness mask; rejected trials do not enter the authoritative ledger.

nodes.title: Canonical interval water-balance residual
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 equation
nodes.notes: R = (S_end - S_start) - (Q_in - Q_out), where interval flux terms are accumulated amounts over accepted transactions. Closure requires the relevant accounting to be complete and finite and the applicable hard gate to pass.

nodes.title: Accepted-only canonical mass accounting
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 formulation
nodes.notes: Only accepted transaction contributions are accumulated. Missing contribution bits and non-finite terms make interval accounting incomplete rather than silently closing the balance.

nodes.title: Interval conservation accounting formulation
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 formulation
nodes.notes: The continuous conservation requirement is represented over arbitrary [t0,t1], independently of calendar boundaries.

nodes.title: Accepted-transaction mass aggregation
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 runtime
nodes.notes: Interval totals are the sum of accepted transaction inflows/outflows; storage change is endpoint difference.

nodes.title: Hard per-transaction mass acceptance gate
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 transaction core
nodes.notes: Reference transaction trials whose mass residual exceeds the configured hard mass tolerance are rejected; RB1 qualification separately requires hard mass conservation.

nodes.title: Accepted-only mass ledger algorithm
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 runtime
nodes.notes: Accumulate accepted transaction amounts exactly once, compute endpoint storage change and interval residual, propagate completeness/missing-contribution state.

nodes.title: Canonical accepted-only interval ledger implementation
nodes.notes: Frozen blob 55f3d271aa6200a994fd0144d6fce0701c918a74; transaction-level hard mass rejection is in execute_reference_interval.

nodes.title: Deterministic canonical diagnostics aggregation
nodes.authority: F-DOC03 documentation of frozen RB1 runtime
nodes.notes: Transaction counts, retries, rollbacks, rejection categories, solver counters, temporal indicators and mass residual extrema are accumulated deterministically into interval diagnostics.

nodes.title: Canonical diagnostics publication implementation
nodes.notes: Diagnostics type is defined in frozen blob c06aa869a0bd479df4c7d6e1d0b4f5c07a207144 and aggregation in frozen blob 55f3d271aa6200a994fd0144d6fce0701c918a74.

edges.rationale: The generic interval is advanced as accepted substeps and atomically published at interval completion.
Independent controlled theory/source binding remains open.
Concept is documented but its controlled T1 source binding remains open.

T0.rationale: Generic interval orchestration is not itself a physical phenomenon.

T1.rationale: No physical theory is introduced by generic interval orchestration.

T2.rationale: No independent physical conceptual model is introduced.

T3.rationale: No independent physical equation system is defined by this capability.

T4.rationale: No SWAP-specific physical parameterisation belongs to this capability.

T5.rationale: No independent continuous physical formulation belongs to this runtime capability.

T7.rationale: Acceptance/retry numerical policy is owned by RB1-CORE-TRANSACTION and temporal-science capabilities, not by interval orchestration itself.

T12.rationale: Observational validation is not the appropriate evidence class for generic runtime interval atomicity; physical application validation belongs to process/model capabilities.

T0.rationale: Data-category separation is software architecture, not a physical phenomenon.

T1.rationale: No scientific theory is asserted by the data ownership split.

T2.rationale: No physical conceptual model is asserted.

T5.rationale: No continuous physical formulation is asserted.

T6.rationale: No discretisation is defined by data ownership itself.

T7.rationale: No numerical solver method is defined by data ownership itself.

T8.rationale: The capability is a structural contract rather than an execution algorithm.

T12.rationale: Observational validation is not applicable to software data-category separation.

T0.rationale: Transaction atomicity is runtime semantics, not a physical phenomenon.

T2.rationale: No physical conceptual model is introduced.

T3.rationale: No independent physical equation system is introduced.

T5.rationale: No continuous physical formulation is introduced.

T6.rationale: The transaction protocol itself is independent of a specific spatial/temporal discretisation; temporal trial routes are numerical acceptance machinery.

T12.rationale: Observational validation is not the appropriate evidence class for transaction atomicity.

Conservation/accounting correctness is verified as an identity and hard numerical invariant at T11; observational application validation belongs to the physical model/process capabilities whose fluxes feed the ledger.

T0.rationale: Diagnostics aggregation is observability infrastructure, not a physical phenomenon.

T2.rationale: No physical conceptual model is introduced.

T3.rationale: No physical equation system is introduced.

T5.rationale: No continuous physical formulation is introduced.

T6.rationale: Diagnostics aggregation does not define discretisation.

T7.rationale: Diagnostics aggregation does not define the solver method it observes.

T12.rationale: Observational validation is not applicable to deterministic runtime diagnostics aggregation.
